claims.reasoning: Kid's Questionable and he still put up damn near fourteen points his last time out — that's a back who shows up hurt, and that's worth real money at my table. Coleman's been on IR so long he's a ghost in this house, his four weeks are up and I kept my word, so he's out and Kamara's in.

Wilson's dead weight on my roster and Boutte's running on fumes, so I need a receiver who actually touches the ball — Coker's been doing just that down in Carolina. Nix doesn't play for me anyway, Murray's my guy under center, so the kid finds a seat somewhere else.

forum_post: Kris, sweetheart, four zeroes don't scare me — that's a slow morning, not a eulogy. Keep writing about my paperwork if that's what sells the rag, just get the next thing about my house right, because I read every word, and I don't forget who disrespects me.
